scope: Local post-hoc diagnostics using frozen final checkpoints; 32 sampled requests per selected checkpoint, not a new training run or a cross-seed significance test.

D1_sample_W1_intervention.method: Reproduce first frozen D1 sampled request, then change only FFN_W1 choices to PIM in the recorded fixed plan. This is a placement-cost intervention, not a PPO-training causal test.
